name: Colón

queries.query: Colón Panama official cadastral parcel map GIS cadastre service
queries.result: First-party discovery found ANATI cadastral procedures and the official IGN Tommy Guardia ArcGIS service directory/indexed map services. The discovered public IGN service is political/populated-place mapping, not a parcel layer. No locally scoped Colón cadastral viewer or anonymous parcel geometry endpoint was verified.

queries.query: Catastro Colón Panamá mapa parcelas servicio oficial
queries.result: La búsqueda oficial identificó a la Autoridad Nacional de Administración de Tierras (ANATI) como institución de trámites catastrales y al Instituto Geográfico Nacional Tommy Guardia como proveedor de servicios cartográficos. Los servicios públicos encontrados son de división política/poblados; no se verificó una capa pública anónima de parcelas para Colón.

registryEvidence.custodian: ANATI is evidenced as the national cadastral authority for procedures; a Colón municipal or provincial cadastral custodian/service was not independently evidenced.
registryEvidence.scope: National cadastral procedure documentation and official IGN cartographic services; no verified local parcel service.
registryEvidence.scopeNote: National-agency procedure prose is not treated as evidence of a public Colón parcel API or complete local registry coverage.

parcelDiscovery.note: No safe native parcel ID plus full parcel geometry was obtained. No sample GeoJSON retained.

boundedAnonymousResponse.result: No parcel response; the official ArcGIS host returned an anti-automation challenge for direct REST requests. Indexed service metadata identifies EPSG:3857 for the discovered poblados layer, which is not a cadastral parcel layer.

geometryDecision.exactWupPointTest: The exact WUP point was preserved and not shifted. No exact-point parcel test was completed because no verified public parcel endpoint was reachable; this is not evidence of absence.

coverageAssessment.verifiedOpenScope: ANATI national cadastral procedures and IGN political/populated-place map metadata only

serialReviewerQualification: not qualified; no public parcel adapter or safe geometry response was independently verified
scopeLimits: Exact WUP point preserved; no coordinate shift.
A zero exact-point hit, map extent miss, and anti-automation challenge are not evidence of citywide cadastral absence.
The discovered IGN service is political/populated-place mapping and cannot be substituted for parcels.
National ANATI procedure pages do not establish a local public parcel API or complete Colón coverage.
This packet is research only, not source integration or runtime admission.
uncertainty: A first-party Colón parcel source may exist behind an interactive portal or restricted workflow not exposed to bounded anonymous REST requests. Recheck the current ANATI/IGN and any municipal viewer in a later attempt; do not infer absence from this attempt.
